intro: We do not publish package prices, because a roof is not a package. What it costs depends on the square footage, the pitch, how many layers are up there, the material you choose, and what the decking looks like once the old roof comes off — and nobody can know that last one from the driveway. What we will do is get on the roof, photograph what we find, and hand you a written estimate with the scope and the number on it. Take that estimate and compare it against anyone else's. The Better Business Bureau tells Miami Valley homeowners to collect three written quotes before committing, and we would rather be one of your three than the contractor who talked you out of getting them.
notes: Free inspections and free written estimates throughout the Miami Valley. If we get up there and find your roof has years left in it, we will tell you that instead.
